# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run native Windows jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. Native Windows build and process checks contribute to the pull-request `all checks passed` verdict; Wine runs Windows Node on hosted Linux only in `ci-master.yml`. Python runtime CI checks Linux/Windows x64 on pull requests and Linux ARM64 plus both macOS architectures on master pushes; releases retain all five targets ([platform policy](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-06-master-only-platform-ci.md)). `ci.yml` is pull-request-only and every job in it uses standard GitHub-hosted runners. Master-only platform checks, explicitly opted-in Linux/Windows self-hosted standbys, and manual runner benchmarks live in `ci-master.yml`, which listens to master pushes and `workflow_dispatch`, not `pull_request`; separating workflow triggers keeps master-only jobs out of PR check panels. The standbys run only for a private repository whose `DSH_CI_PRIVATE_RUNNER_REPOSITORY` variable equals `github.repository`; the variable is scheduling opt-in, not runner authorization. Keep private runner-group access restricted outside workflow YAML ([public hosted CI decision](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-10-public-hosted-ci.md)).

The fork-only `ci-fork-master.yml` (master push, master-bound `pull_request`, and `workflow_dispatch` on `ubuntu-latest`) exists because the upstream master-only platform checks and self-hosted standbys are not available to a fork. It runs the shared `check:ci:static` aggregate plus the unit suite keyless with `contents: read`, a job-level `github.repository == 'Abaddollyon/deepseek-harness'` guard keeps it skipped everywhere else the file travels with the repository (and pins manual dispatch to master), and it never joins the upstream required lanes — see the [fork master hosted CI Agent Note](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-30-fork-master-hosted-ci.md).
